algorithm.title: Suspected Spondylolysis or Spondylolisthesis in Young Athletes.

cell.label: Low back pain in young athlete
Positive 1-legged hyperextension test (does not rule out active spondylolysis if negative) or abnormal AP/Lat/Oblique radiographs of lumbar spine.
cell.path: No, but high index of suspicion (at-risk athlete)
No and not a high-risk athlete

cell.label: Relative rest for at least 2-4 weeks, NSAIDs or acetaminophen for pain.
CT scan, consider MRI in case of associated neural compression or young age.
Consider bracing if still symptomatic after 2-4 weeks.
Return to play when pain free activity. If symptoms persist, consider referral.
